verdict.rationale: Attio ships its own AI agents (Ask Attio, workflow agents), so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence shows users can register external MCP servers for those agents to call. The documented official MCP server (attio-probe-3, attio-docs-3) is the server role, which lets outside AI tools manage Attio, not the reverse. The App SDK's HTTP requests and workflow blocks are developer building blocks, not MCP client support.
